items.title: Every blade has a story now
items.body: New AURN tooltips: rarity by power, a tagline and lore for every weapon, armour and relic, animated sect manuals, and gear that hits a little harder.

items.title: The AURN Launcher is here
items.body: One click installs and updates the whole pack and takes you straight to the AURN server.

items.title: A new Reach is being forged
items.body: Huge mountain ranges, wuxia sects and Western kingdoms, joined by roads that follow the land.
